## get

Get per-user inbox access settings. `GET /users/{user_id}/inbox-access`

Get the target user's inbox-access mode + the inboxes they're listed in.

Returns 200 with {mode: 'all', inbox_ids: []} for a freshly-added team member who has no overrides — mode defaults to 'all' (PRIMARY server_default) and the SHARD grant list starts empty.

```php
$result = $sendseven->userInboxAccess()->get(userId: 'user_id');
```

- Scopes: `team:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `UserInboxAccessResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/User%20Inbox%20Access/get_user_inbox_access_api_v1_users__user_id__inbox_access_get)

## update

Update per-user inbox access settings. `PUT /users/{user_id}/inbox-access`

Update the user's mode + replace their per-inbox grants.

Behaviour: - Validates target user is a member of this tenant (404 otherwise — using 404 over 403 to avoid an existence oracle). - Validates every inbox_ids element belongs to this tenant (422 otherwise). - Updates tenant_users.inbox_access_mode on PRIMARY. - Reconciles the user's rows in custom_inbox_users on SHARD to the target set (delete grants no longer wanted, insert only missing ones).

```php
$result = $sendseven->userInboxAccess()->update(userId: 'user_id', mode: 'mode');
```

- Scopes: `team:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$mode` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$inboxIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$contactHistoryVisibility` | `?string` | no |  |

Returns `UserInboxAccessResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/User%20Inbox%20Access/update_user_inbox_access_api_v1_users__user_id__inbox_access_put)
